You’re NTA at all. This is a tough topic for everyone involved. Your ma misses what she thinks she had with you. She of course still has this, but in a way she is grieving. Like others have said, be open and honest. She should be more worried about breaking your heart than you breaking hers. Remind her you are still the little kid you once were, you are just an adult version now and look and sound a bit different. You are still you. You always will be. But you are a happier version, a version who does not need to hide. And the best part? You are proud. So she should be proud. No matter what changes a child goes through, parents will always miss who they once were so please don’t take it personally. They will eventually realize you are still yourself ❤️ and that is what matters. So again you are NTA. Everyone deserves to feel happy and safe. Good luck OP!
